LESSON: MUSICAL INSTRUMENTS

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.3: Musical Instruments

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Musical Instruments. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: when playing different wind instrument?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify different wind guided in identifying the instruments visually and aurally used to accompany song and dance,
2. demonstrate the skills of playing a wind instrument as a basis of skills development,
3. improvise accompaniments to songs and dances using improvised wind instruments for enjoyment, e) observe own and others improvising wind using locally safety in improvising and available materials. playing instruments, 327 NOT FOR SALE f) appreciate own improvised musical instruments and accompaniments and those of others, g) observe safety and care of improvised instrument for the instrument in presentation and sharing maintenance and storage, h) play virtual musical instruments to enhance playing skills and for digital literacy.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At home, obey your parent when they ask you to wash your plate. That shows obedience.

Example 2: Tell the truth if you break a cup. Saying what really happened is honesty.

Example 3: Thank God for your family before you sleep. A short prayer can be: “Thank you God for today.”

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Musical Instruments.
2. Explain Musical Instruments to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Musical Instruments.
4. Show that you can: identify different wind guided in identifying the instruments visually and aurally used to accompany song and dance,
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Musical Instruments. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: when playing different wind instrument?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.
